qualified_terrain_state_note: only explicit qualified_state/state_name metadata is used; pitch alone is not ascent/descent qualification

split_audit.geometry_scope: shared terrain geometry can occur across independent parent runs; missing hashes are not evidence of disjoint geometry

metadata.subset_rule: known geometry hash not in any training record; no model tuning; hash distinctness alone is not broad unseen-terrain generalization

inference_benchmark.scope: host CPU; excludes output geometry/serialization; not measured on robot PC

metrics.moving_definition: not sample_index.is_initial; includes subsequent low-speed/stalled windows
metrics.difference_direction: current_minus_reference; negative error difference favors current
